twenty_questions.title: Twenty questions
twenty_questions.intro: You can use this sheet to fill in your answers to The Game of Twenty Questions, and to take notes for later!
twenty_questions.section: Legend of the Five Rings Core Rulebook, Chapter 2 : Creating a character, p. 41-95
twenty_questions.generchar_disclaimer: Warning, this will erase character's current datas !

part1.title: Part I: Core Identity (Clan and Family)
part1.q1: 1. What clan does your character belong to ? (p. 41)
part1.q2: 2. What family does your character belong to ? (p. 49)

part2.title: Part II: Role and School
part2.q3: 3. What is your character’s school, and what roles does that school fall into ? (p. 56)
part2.q4: 4. How does your character stand out within their school ? (p. 88)

part3.title: Part III: Honor and Glory
part3.q5: 5. Who is your lord and what is your character’s duty to them ? (p. 88)
part3.q6: 6. What does your character long for, and how might this impede their duty ? (p. 90)
part3.q7: 7. What is your character’s relationship with their clan ? (p. 91)
part3.q8: 8. What does your character think of Bushidō ? (p. 91)

part4.title: Part IV: Strengths and Weaknesses
part4.q9: 9. What is your character’s greatest accomplishment so far ? (p. 92)
part4.q10: 10. What holds your character back the most in life ? (p. 92)
part4.q11: 11. What activity Most makes your character feel at peace ? (p. 93)
part4.q12: 12. What concern, fear, or foible troubles your character the most ? (p. 93)
part4.q13: 13. Who has your character learned the most from during their life (p. 93)

part5.title: Part V: Personality and Behavior
part5.q14: 14. What do people notice first upon encountering your character? (p. 93)
part5.q15: 15. How does your character react to stressful situations ? (p. 94)
part5.q16: 16. What are your character’s preexisting relationships with other clans, families, organizations, and traditions ? (p. 94)

part6.title: Part VI: Ancestry and Family
part6.q17: 17. How would your character’s parents describe them ? (p. 95)
part6.q18: 18. Who was your character named to honor ? (p. 95)
part6.q19: 19. What is your character’s personal name ? (p. 95)
